_comment: Base allow-list is intentionally stack-agnostic — only universal, read-only, non-destructive commands — plus this project's Python build/lint/test tooling (pip, pytest, mypy, ruff), which is local and reversible. Deliberately NOT allow-listed: `python agent.py` — running the live agent can write a real Google Calendar event and create Gmail drafts, i.e. it has side effects on shared external systems, so it should prompt every time like any other state-changing action. Never add destructive commands (rm -rf, git push --force, db migrate down, etc.) to 'allow' — those should prompt every time.
